title: True Branch from the Second Field State
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $y$ be a Boolean input word, and let $p$ satisfy $1\le p\le |y|$. Suppose the symbol of $y$ at zero-based position $p-1$ is true. For any Boolean flags $f,b$, bit vector, and auxiliary words $w_X,w_C,w_O$, one step of the constructed machine from state $fB$ produces state $fA$ with flag $f$ and the same bit vector, while advancing the input head to position $p+1$. If $f$ is true, it appends $b$ to $w_O$ and leaves $w_C$ unchanged; if $f$ is false, it appends $b$ to $w_C$ and leaves $w_O$ unchanged. The word $w_X$ is unchanged in either case.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
The symbol at position $p-1$ is true
A bit vector of the prescribed length is given
